question: Oda-sensei hello! I have one question. When Itomimizu's Super Sparrow Chuchun eats food, does it grow teeth, like the Super Spot-Billed Duck Karoo? It was so cute, I was drawn to it instantly. I want to know more about Chuchun. By then! (P.S. I hope more of these Super animals continue to show up!) - Octopus-
answer: Yes, it has teeth. Its favorite foods are Super Worms, Super Sharks, and Super Footballfish.
name: Super Octopus
